summary:
Our project is about NASA equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. We learned about Apollo equipment and different Mars rovers like Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, Curiosity and Perseverance.


These machines helped scientists learn about rocks, soil and the environment of other planets. Even though some machines have stopped working, the information they collected is still useful.


We have presented their journeys and discoveries through storytelling. We want to show that equipment may be left behind, but its discoveries are never forgotten.


Through this project, we learned many interesting things about space exploration and how NASA helps us understand other worlds.
details:
Our project, “Abandoned but Not Forgotten,” is a storytelling presentation about NASA equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars.

We created a PowerPoint presentation to explain the journeys of space equipment, including Apollo scientific instruments and Mars rovers. We researched how these machines explored other worlds, studied rocks and soil, and helped scientists make important discoveries.

Our project helps students understand that even when a space machine stops working, the information it collected is still valuable.

We used Microsoft PowerPoint to create our slides and NASA websites to collect information. We also used pictures, simple explanations and creative storytelling to make our presentation interesting and easy to understand.

We did not use any coding or special hardware. AI assistance was used to help organise ideas and prepare the presentation, and we reviewed the content for our project.

Our aim is to inspire other students to learn about space exploration and understand how past discoveries help future missions.
